svg.title: Nuonuo System Architecture
svg.desc: Four-stage local architecture: Triggers with two-stage filtering, always-on shell-free Router with Split-Phase Voice and Sideband Memory, parallel Workers gated by Policy & Reviewer, and pluggable Execution Environments on top of a single Node.js daemon, SQLite, Watchdog, and Plugin Sandbox.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Subscription Bypass · Follow-ups route straight to Workers
